name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd.
business_summary: Jaipur-based small finance bank moving to universal-bank status; vehicle loans (Wheels AUM above Rs50,000cr), SME, mortgages, credit cards and ex-Fincare microfinance (MFIB, 1,000+ branches). Q2 FY27 PAT Rs858cr (+53%), but shares fell 7-10% on 2026-10-26 as management flagged margin pressure. Shareholding: promoters 22.7%, FIIs 36%, DIIs 32.8%; RBI approved ICICI Prudential AMC buying up to 9.95%. Probing a potential data leak (vehicle-loan customers, 2026-10-30). Stock Rs941, P/E 22.4x, P/B 3.3x, 3m -13%, 12m +7%.

revenue_mix.geography: Rajasthan and north/west heartland, expanding pan-India (model est.)

exposures.mechanism: Mostly fixed-rate vehicle/SME assets (~70%; model est.) vs term deposits repricing: floating assets 0.3 x Rs1.3 lakh cr x 25bp = Rs98cr/yr; deposit repricing on ~Rs1.0 lakh cr of TDs at ~70% beta => Rs175cr; net -Rs77cr = -1.8% of PBT (~Rs4,200cr); persistence 0.5 => -0.9; P/E 22x multiple effect => -2.5. Management flagged margin pressure on the Q2 call (stock -7 to -10% on 2026-10-26).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs858cr (+53%) (Moneycontrol/The Hindu 2026-10-24); shares fell 7-10% on 2026-10-26 after management flagged margin pressure (CNBC TV18/ET/Livemint 2026-10-26); Jefferies and Motilal see up to 37% upside
RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening', first hike in ~4 years (The Hindu 2026-10-07; Business Standard 2026-10-14: near-term cuts off the table)
